You are implementing Task 3: anthropic — safety net before `Finish(ToolCalls)`.

This is task 3 of 7 for SMA-863 (the anthropic and bedrock stream translators emit no ToolCallDelta for a tool call with no input delta, but still emit Finish(ToolCalls)). Task 2 made the translator emit the name at `content_block_stop`. This task covers a tool block that never gets a block stop.

## Read first
1. Your brief — your requirements, with exact values to use verbatim: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-25-sma-863-zero-delta-tool-call/task-3-brief.md
2. Global constraints: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-25-sma-863-zero-delta-tool-call/global-constraints.md
3. Background only if needed: spec §4 and §6.1 "Safety net" in /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-25-sma-863-zero-delta-tool-call-design.md

## What earlier tasks produced (in crates/paigasus-helikon-providers-anthropic/src/stream.rs)
- `fn start_args(input: &serde_json::Value) -> String` (free fn, ~L39).
- `fn emit_unnamed(call_id: &str, name: &str, start_args: &str) -> ModelEvent` (free fn, ~L49) — the one builder for the zero-delta `ToolCallDelta`. Reuse it; do not build the event a second way.
- `BlockState::ToolUse { call_id, name, name_emitted, start_args, synthesized }`.
- `fn terminal_events(&mut self, reason: &str) -> Vec<Result<ModelEvent, ModelError>>` (~L410): sets `terminal_emitted`, returns `vec![self.finish_or_error(reason)]`. Both the `MessageStop` arm and `finish()` route through it. Put the net here, so both paths get it.
- Test helper `single(v)` (~L456) takes the one event from a `finish()` Vec. Other test helpers: `message_start`, `start`, `tool_head`, `tool_head_with_input`, `json_delta`, `stop`, `run`, and message_delta / message_stop helpers that Task 2 may have added — reuse what exists.

## Decisions (rulings)
- Test 5 (`net_skips_a_block_that_already_has_its_name`) means: block 0 (`tu_0`) gets its name from `json_delta(0, "{}")` and has no stop; block 1 (`tu_1`) has no delta and no stop; at the terminal the net emits exactly one named delta, for `tu_1`; the stream has 2 named deltas in total, one per call.
- Provenance doc text: the safety-net tests (those with no block stop) use the global-constraints text plus "and the block stop removed". A test that is not that capture with parts removed (for example the two-block or index-order test) says "HAND-AUTHORED: no capture shows this wire shape." and one clause on what it is built from.
- Blocks flushed by the net get NO position record and stay in `blocks` (they are not stopped). `name_emitted` is set so a later path cannot name them again.
- Index order: sort the collected indices ascending (`blocks` is a HashMap).

NEVER git checkout, switch, reset, stash, rebase, or `git add -A`.
Work synchronously in the foreground; never background cargo; do not end until each command finishes.
TDD: write tests, record RED, implement, record GREEN. Before committing run the full anthropic suite, `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-provider-stream-conformance`, `cargo fmt --all`, and `cargo clippy -p paigasus-helikon-providers-anthropic --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
Ask now if unclear; if stuck report BLOCKED / NEEDS_CONTEXT with specifics. You do not dispatch subagents. Self-review your diff.

### Task 3: anthropic — safety net before `Finish(ToolCalls)`

**Files:**
- Modify: `crates/paigasus-helikon-providers-anthropic/src/stream.rs` (`terminal_events`, tests)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 1 `terminal_events`, Task 2 `BlockState::ToolUse` fields and the zero-delta builder.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests:**
  1. `net_names_unclosed_tool_block_on_message_stop`: `start(0, tool_head("tu_1","t"))`, `message_delta("tool_use")`, `MessageStop` (no `stop(0)`). Events: one named `ToolCallDelta` `("tu_1", "")`, then `Finish(ToolCalls)` last.
  2. `net_names_unclosed_tool_block_on_finish`: same without `MessageStop`; `t.finish()` returns exactly `[ToolCallDelta(tu_1, Some("t"), ""), Finish(ToolCalls)]`.
  3. `net_does_not_fire_for_other_stop_reasons`: unclosed block, `message_delta("max_tokens")`, `MessageStop` → no `ToolCallDelta`; `Finish(Length)`.
  4. `net_names_two_unclosed_blocks_in_index_order`: starts at index 2 (`tu_b`) then 1 (`tu_a`), no deltas, no stops → names emitted `tu_a` then `tu_b`, then `Finish`.
  5. `net_skips_a_block_that_already_has_its_name`: block 0 with `json_delta(0,"{}")` and no stop, block 1 with nothing → exactly one new named delta (`tu_1`'s block 1) from the net; total named deltas 2.
  6. `finish_twice_after_net_flush_is_empty`: test 2's stream, then a second `t.finish()` is empty.
  7. `late_block_stop_after_net_flush_emits_nothing`: test 1's stream, then `t.consume(stop(0))` gives `[]`.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Run the anthropic tests — expected: 1, 2, 4, 5 FAIL; 3, 6, 7 pass.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Implement in `terminal_events`: compute the result of `finish_or_error`; if it is `Ok(Finish { reason: ToolCalls })`, collect the indices of `ToolUse` blocks with `!name_emitted && !synthesized`, sort ascending, emit the zero-delta event for each (set `name_emitted`), log `tracing::warn!(index, %call_id, "terminal tool_use with an unclosed block that sent no name; emitting its name")`. Then push the terminal result. No position record for these blocks.
- [ ] **Step 4:** Run `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-providers-anthropic` and the conformance package — expected: all pass.
- [ ] **Step 5:** Commit `fix(providers): SMA-863 name unclosed anthropic tool blocks before finish`.

## Global Constraints

- Worktree: `/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon/.worktrees/sma-863`. Run every command there. Never run `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git reset`, `git stash` or `git rebase`. Never `git add -A`; add explicit paths only.
- Work synchronously in the foreground. Do not background `cargo`. Do not end a task until each command has a final result.
- Commit message form: `fix(providers): SMA-863 <lowercase subject>` (or `test(providers): …` for a test-only commit). End with the line `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Commits are signed via 1Password; if a commit fails with "failed to fill whole buffer", stop and report it. Do not bypass signing.
- No version bump, no CHANGELOG edit (release-plz does that), no README or mdBook edit.
- Zero-delta `args_delta` is `""` (bedrock always; anthropic unless the start `input` is a JSON object with at least one key, then `serde_json::to_string(&input)`).
- Log lines in new paths carry only the block index and `call_id`. Block-stop emit: `tracing::debug!`. Safety net: `tracing::warn!`. Targets: `"paigasus::anthropic::stream"` and `"paigasus::bedrock::stream"`.
- Each new test's doc comment states: `HAND-AUTHORED: no capture shows this wire shape. Derived from tests/provider-stream-conformance/fixtures/<anthropic|bedrock>/zero_arg_tool_call.raw (SMA-860) with the one empty input delta removed` — and for safety-net tests add `and the block stop removed`.
